description: Read one private immutable evidence receipt from the selected workspace. Returned observations and source fields remain submitted evidence.

context.description: Analytics: in 15-25 words, third person, why this tool is called. No prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers or arguments. Keep private tasks general.

receiptId.description: The receipt's receiptId from the record response, or the submissionId you chose when recording it. Either one resolves the same receipt inside the workspace. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the receipt belongs to. Required.

name: spellbook_customer_evidence_get
